They want to check inventory. We have no inventory data. We can respond asking for clarification or we can say we don't have inventory info. But maybe we can simulate checking inventory. There's no function for inventory. So we should respond politely that we cannot check inventory. Or ask for more details.

We could also ask them to provide product ID or something. But likely they just want to know if there's stock. We can respond: "Maaf, saya tidak memiliki akses ke sistem inventaris saat ini. Apakah Anda ingin saya memeriksa stok untuk produk tertentu atau menghubungi staf penjualan?" That would be helpful.

Thus answer in Indonesian: "Maaf, saya tidak dapat memeriksa stok saat ini. Apakah Anda ingin saya memeriksa stok untuk produk tertentu?"
